rows.NPC & MONSTER DEFENSIVE MOVE: The creature’s next attack receives an additional +10 to its Combat Skill. If it’s a magic action, the PC’s Spellward is reduced by -10 until the creature’s next turn.
Reduce the PC’s Armor by -1 in a random Hit Location until the end of combat.
The PC receives the Bleeding (1) condition.
The creature clears all negative conditions that it is currently suffering from, if any.
The PC receives 1 Piercing damage that ignores Armor.
The creature’s next damaging Action receives +D6 damage to its Damage Pool. If it’s not a damaging Action, then the PC’s Spellward is reduced by -10 until the creature’s next turn.
The creature gains Advantage on its next attack. If the attack is a Magical one, then the PC rolls its Spellward with Disadvantage.
The PC’s next Dodge, Parry, or Spellward check is reduced by -20.
The creature gets a new turn immediately.
